limitations: The supplied Celo archive preserves only 2025 game-level pregame probabilities; 2008-2024 row-level probabilities were not bundled.
The 2025 probabilities are rounded to three decimals in the UI export, so replay Brier differs slightly from the canonical exact 2025 aggregate.
Weeks 4-6 are a temporal holdout relative to the Week 2-3 selection direction, but this is not a multi-season out-of-sample validation.
The feature is therefore explicitly provisional and should be revalidated across historical seasons when row-level predictions are available.
